Connor / Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from compliance: 

1) In-scope systems — confirm the following mapping is used for evidence requests:
   - runtime (inference engine, KV cache) -> controls on processing confidentiality & integrity
   - model artifacts (S3) -> controls on access, versioning, artifact scanning
   - control plane (console & API) -> admin access, RBAC, audit trails

2) Log retention: our standard operational retention is 90 days in hot storage, 365 days in cold storage (compressed); for FedRAMP evidence we will export the 90-day hot slice and provide hash/proof of retention for the cold slice. If auditors require raw log dumps for specific windows, we'll coordinate redaction with Security.

3) Evidence format guidance (please advise to external team):
   - Configs: cloud console export (json) + screenshot of IAM role bindings
   - Runtime: 7 days of representative logs + sample request/response with timestamps (redacted PII)
   - Governance: PDF policy with change history (Doc metadata)

4) Control owners: I reviewed the draft mapping — I moved a few items to "needs infra owner" and added expected delivery dates. Owners must provide either a link to the artifact (internal Drive path) or upload to the shared evidence folder by Nov 30.

5) SOC 2 overlap: many SIG items map to SOC 2 CC and ISO controls. For efficiency, label artifacts with both IDs in the artifact path (e.g., /evidence/ISO27001/ISO_A.8_20261120.pdf).

I attached a short evidence snapshot (evidence_snapshot_20261120.zip) listing filenames and owners to illustrate the naming scheme.

If AuditWorks can confirm the acceptable evidence types and the Nov 30 commit date, we’ll move to owner-level assignments and start collection.

Laura Bennett
